Research 22.09.2026 Major grant for new nature restoration centre Denmark is undertaking an ambitious effort to restore nature. A new research centre has now been awarded DKK 50 million to investigate what works, what does not, and how ecosystems can best be brought back to life. Read article

Teaching Award 22.09.2026 SDU Associate Professor receives the 2026 Teaching Award Associate Professor Bjarne Schmidt from the University of Southern Denmark has been awarded the 2026 Teaching Award for his dedicated and practical teaching in physics and mathematics. Read article

Literature Award 14.09.2026 Award-Winning Author Zadie Smith Visits SDU Meet acclaimed British author Zadie Smith at SDU on Monday, 5 October, for a conversation about her writing and readings from selected works. Read article

Innovator of the month 09.09.2026 SDU entrepreneur aims to make clothes from spider silk Drawing inspiration from nature’s own solutions, Irina Iachina is working to develop a sustainable alternative to elastane. As a researcher and entrepreneur, she aims to translate research into spider silk into new materials that can reduce the textile industry’s carbon footprint. Read article

SDU Vejle 01.09.2026 SDU Vejle officially opened Following several years of preparation, SDU Vejle has officially opened. The new international IT campus aims to train more IT specialists and build strong research environments in close collaboration with businesses in the region. Read article

SDU Business School 31.08.2026 SDU establishes a new Business School From 1 September, SDU will bring together its business and economics academic communities under the SDU Business School. The new faculty is intended to enhance the quality of research and teaching, strengthen collaboration with the business community, and bolster the university’s international standing. Read article

SDU 28.08.2026 Anne Binderkrantz to become new Pro-rector at SDU Professor of Political Science Anne Skorkjær Binderkrantz is to become the new Pro-rector at the University of Southern Denmark. She joins from Aarhus University and has extensive experience in research, educational leadership and strategic university management. Read article

Research 26.08.2026 SDU joins new national partnership on children and nature The University of Southern Denmark is joining forces with 15 other organisations, research and educational institutions and foundations in a strengthened Centre for Children and Nature. Among other things, SDU will contribute research and knowledge on active living among children and young people and on learning and teaching in primary and lower secondary school. Read article

Research 25.08.2026 Anton Pottegård wins the Research Communication Award The annual award, presented to a researcher who has distinguished themselves through outstanding communication within their field of research, goes to SDU – specifically, Professor Anton Pottegård from the Faculty of Health Sciences. Read article

Research 11.08.2026 New maritime research centre opens at SDU The University of Southern Denmark conducts extensive research within the maritime field. A new centre, supported by the Danish Maritime Fund, will bring researchers together and strengthen collaboration across the university's faculties. Read article

Health technology Knowledge and solutions for the future of healthcare The healthcare system is short of labour, and the challenge will not diminish in the future with the prospect of more elderly citizens and patients. At SDU, researchers are developing new technology that can strengthen treatment, prevention and patient care - for the benefit of both healthcare and society. Read more
